issue.title: Make Bob Mac Capture pure indentation helpers nonisolated
issue.description: Discovered by the bob-cli-t land agent while verifying the epic. macOS 26 CI runs 31890751259, 31892336680, and 31892613742 reach the Test step after format/build, then fail compiling BobMacCaptureTests because CapturePanelController.bulletIndentationEdit(direction:in:selectedRange:) is implicitly @MainActor but its pure synchronous tests are nonisolated (ActorIsolatedCall across BobMacCaptureTests.swift:897-1169). The defect was introduced before bob-cli-t by 3898739, but blocks full-suite, bundle, install, and smoke validation for both active epics bob-cli-t and bob-cli-u. Make the pure resolver and its pure helper dependency chain explicitly nonisolated where safe (leaving AppKit/model mutation main-actor isolated), retain the nonisolated tests as the contract, and verify the full macOS 26 workflow proceeds beyond Test.

payload.entry: RELATED: bob-cli-t — this pre-existing compile defect blocks the full macOS validation required before the multi-item capture epic can close.
